topic: Big tech needs to justify AI spending as investors dump stocks
headline: AI Spending Under Scrutiny Now
caption: As a full stack engineer, I see firsthand how AI projects can quickly spiral into costly efforts without clear ROI. Big tech's push into AI needs to justify the huge budgets, especially when investors are pulling back. It's a reminder that even the most advanced tech must deliver tangible value. Let's keep our focus on building scalable, impactful solutions that stand the test of market scrutiny 🔍. Are AI investments sustainable without real performance metrics? Share your thoughts below! #AI #TechInvesting #FullStackEngineer #StartupLife
